text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Lavender or sandalwood...
One of the two. Which shall it be?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's quite right, Alf-san!
Let us bring the sandalwood one, which can purify the entire room with a single puff.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Everything is in order now.
Well then—I am off, Alv-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that reminds me.
I shall leave seven photos of myself, so please display a different one each day of the week.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
I don't really need—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I shall always be watching over you.
—And I will return as an even more exalted saint.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...It finally got quiet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At last, the day has come to depart Japan for the Breeders' Cup.
I went to pick up Red Desire to board the limousine bus arranged by our team, only to find—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Everything necessary for the race has already been arranged by Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I will take only what is necessary to remain a holy maiden. Everything else—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"My resolve to overcome this special trial,
and the feelings everyone has placed in me.
With just those, I have more than enough."
choice_data_list: ...All right. I'll hold onto your bag.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —...So you're going.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san...!
Are you here to... see me off?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I really wish I could've chased after them all the way to the airport on my bike, though~.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even without a bike, Vodka is...
always, at all times... so cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, it sounds different than usual.
Like there's real weight to it... Is it because
you're challenging such an incredible stage after all?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Everrryone's saying it: "Desire is incredible,"
"Just challenging it is amazing in itself!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So you've gathered a crazy amount of hope before even getting started.
But... that's not all you've got, right?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
There may be value in taking up the challenge. However—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To pour down the light of hope with an unprecedented victory.
That is truly the only way to repay those feelings.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Must be nice.
You really are cool after all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Here, take this—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Vodka flicks something into the air with a snap of her fingers. Tracing a clean arc, it—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Is this... aluminum?
Looks like a ring...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"It's made from a piece of the horseshoe
I wore during the Nippon Derby!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I bent it into shape by force, so it might be
a bit clunky, but...
It's guaranteed to bring good luck!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Besides... you get lonely easily, don'tcha?
You'll feel safer holding onto this, right?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...!!
It can't be—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This charm is thin, circular...
and just about the size of my finger.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In other words... this is... without a shadow of a doubt—
a ring!! Vodka gave me a ring...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wait, no, that's wrong...!
A horseshoe! That's shaped like a horseshoe!!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"A-A-A-Anyway!!
...Go blow 'em away, Desire!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Go out there and prove to the whole world
just how incredible you are!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Vodka-san.
I promise you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Drawing strength even from your prayers—
this Saint Desire shall bestow hope upon you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer.
This trial... we will surely overcome it."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
May the light of the Saint shine upon everyone—
I shall bestow a light so intense
it can reach you even from that distant land.
